summary.text: Jim Maggiore is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Rockingham 23 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 primary.
Maggiore is a business owner, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Jim Maggiore was born on Long Island, New York, and lives in North Hampton, New Hampshire.
He earned a B.A. from Stonehill College in 1990, and his career experience includes owning BioPro Technology.
Maggiore has served on the board of directors of the New Hampshire Municipal Association, the Town of North Hampton Select Board, and the Town of North Hampton Heritage Commission.
Ballotpedia lists Maggiore's tenure in the New Hampshire House of Representatives as beginning in 2018.
